purpose: Private Cloudflare MCP for scheduled Instapaper duplicate checks and approval-only, readback-verified saves.
identitySource: git rev-parse HEAD, git status --short --branch, and repo-structure.render.json

representativeJobs.acceptedOutcome: The home route renders without a fatal error.
The HTTP boundary returns a Schema-decoded domain item list.
The RPC client invokes the schema-owned operation through its handler Layer.
Candidate URLs and titles are checked against unread, starred and archived Instapaper bookmarks without a write.

representativeJobs.consumer: Cooper through an interactive Codex task
representativeJobs.acceptedOutcome: One approved article is saved through the Full API and reported successful only after readback passes.

boundaryFacts: Browser runtime uses Fetch while server loaders use the in-process HTTP client.
Effect execution and runtime composition are application-owned.
The MCP/OAuth fetch handler is a third-party host adapter; Instapaper policy and outbound HTTP remain Effect-owned.
Alchemy and Cloudflare state requires approved provider readback; repository configuration owns desired state only.
exclusions: Dependencies, generated build output, caches, binaries, vendored files, and inaccessible external systems.
nonClaims: The repository is bootstrapped locally but the product implementation remains under development.
Local verification does not prove preview, production, provider, release, deployment, or publication behavior.
